hooks.name: Run property tests after numeric changes
hooks.description: After a save under src/computers/l1/ or src/computers/bench/, ask the agent to run the property tests. Enforced for real by the pre-commit test run.

action.prompt: A numeric module under src/computers/l1/ or src/computers/bench/ was just saved. Run `uv run pytest tests/property -q` and report any failure before continuing. If the change touched a comparison on magnitudes, remember that a smaller magnitude is brighter, and check there is a test on both sides of the boundary. A changed threshold also needs a decision record (see .kiro/steering/testing.md).
